intro.title: Heliodor Stone
intro.description: Heliodor is a semi-precious gemstone of lovely Yellow color and is also called Golden Beryl and Yellow Beryl. The name Heliodor is derived from the Greek words "Helios" (the name of the Greek Sun God), which translates to "Sun” and "Doron," meaning gift. So the Golden Beryl meaning or Heliodor crystal meaning sums up to 'gift from the Sun'. Heliodor healing properties and Heliodor Metaphysical properties are well known across different cultures. Occurrence of this stone in nature is rare but it is a popular stone.

tabs.tab1_description:
Heliodor gemstone is a fire gemstone that reveals your inner fire. It is believed to boost confidence, strength, and resolve. As a yellow gemstone, yellow beryl inherently associates to intellect, joy, and self-assurance, enhancing concentration and success. It is, without a doubt, a revitalizing gemstone and a powerful companion for achieving your healthiest, most confident self. Heliodor is one of the most powerful stones for helping us connect with and gain control over our health and vitality.

Heliodor stone or Golden Beryl Stone works on the Thymus Chakra, which is located between the Throat Chakra (Vishuddha Chakra) and the Heart Chakra (Anahata Chakra). When you wear or carry the Heliodor gemstone it opens, cleanses, and balances the Thymus Chakra. These transpersonal features of the higher Chakra facilitate Divine inner transformation and spiritual broadening.

The High Heart Chakra or Thymus Chakra, thus, is intricately linked with your overall vitality and well-being. An open Thymus Chakra helps one to be forgiving, soulful, and full of compassion. People with an open Thymus Chakra often believe in spreading and passing on these divine gifts of love and compassion to others through their deeds and aura. Heliodor gemstone boosts and regulates the immune system.

In Vedic astrology, the planet Jupiter rules the heliodor gemstone. Jupiter is in charge of luck, money, and success. It also gives you strength, energy, and protection. Yellow Beryl has a lot of healing properties, which makes it good for your health. It also helps improve your financial situation, your bank balance, your wealth, and your social standing.

In Feng Shui, heliodor stones are used to bring about wealth and plenty. They are thought to bring good luck and positive energy. They can be put in a room's "wealth corner" or somewhere where they can get some sun.

Heliodor gives us a lighthouse that can drown out and get rid of any useless habit or action that keeps us from being our true selves. By means of this enlightenment, one will soon be working toward happiness that lasts forever and comes from within.

Yellow beryl, despite its delicate elegance with its pale yellow hues, has a hardness of 7.5-8 on the Mohs scale, which is only slightly lower than the most valuable gemstones.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Heliodor gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Heliodor. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Thymus Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Heliodor inspires feelings of self-assurance, originality, and vitality. It also has a calming effect on the mind and body, assisting individuals in overcoming fear and anxiety. It is also believed that its positive energy promotes an optimistic outlook and encourages people to embrace new opportunities and experiences. It is therefore recommended for anyone in need of profound emotional healing and immune system support.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Heliodor gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Heliodor gemstones.

 

Heliodor Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The best quality Heliodor or Golden Beryl gemstone is found in Namibia with Brazil and Madagascar too having some mines with superior quality. Other countries are Russia, Afghanistan, South Africa and the United States.

Observe their Color:

Originally it is supposed to be white but the presence of Iron impurities gives it the Yellow, Gold or Brownish Yellow, Greenish Yellow or Pale Lime, Orange Yellow colors.

Notice their Clarity:

The finest heliodor gemstones can be identified by their flawless transparency and complete absence of inclusions, therefore exhibiting extraordinary clarity. However, depending on where it was extracted, it may also be opaque.

Examine their Inclusions:

Almost always, Heliodor is free of inclusions, and any present inclusions are only discernible under 10x magnification. Due to the rarity of flaws in natural heliodor stones, even tiny internal inclusions or external fractures can significantly reduce value.

See their Shape:

The most common Heliodor shapes are emerald cushion, emerald cut, marquise, and princess cut. Oval and round shapes are also available, but are less common.

Check the Carats:

For Heliodor of gem quality, the raw Heliodor is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Heliodor weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Heliodor is sold by weight, Heliodor prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Heliodor has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Heliodor:

Due to treatments the Heliodor stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Heliodor do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Heliodor gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Heliodor are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Heliodor from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Heliodor gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

How to Energize & Recharge Heliodor Gemstone?

Heliodor purification alone is insufficient to obtain its desired benefits. Its energization is likewise essential. One must energize his or her Heliodor stone jewelry prior to wearing it.

Perform the activation or energization rituals following the completion of the purification process.

To Cleanse your Heliodor Dip it in Salt Water Solution (If possible, use unprocessed sea salt) OR you can perform the smudging technique using Sage or Palo Santo.

Keep it under Sunlight or Under Full Moon Rays for 10 – 15 mins.

Hold the Heliodor in your hand and Chant the Golden Beryl gemstone Mantra:

Om Brim Brihaspataye Namah || ॐबृं बृहस्पतये नम || 108 times.

While chanting the mantra you can visualize white color positive energy surrounding your Heliodor and restoring its powers.

Other Mantras of Lord Brihaspati (Jupiter) you can chant are mentioned below

Vedic Stotra Mantra for Brihaspati Planet

|| Devaanaancha Risheenaancha Gurum Kaanchan sannibham Bhudhdhi bhootham Thrilokesam Thannamaami Bhruhaspathim ||
I kneel to Brihaspati, lord of Jupiter, who is the preceptor of all gods and rishis. He has a golden skin tone and is the lord of intelligence who controls all three worlds.

Tantrik Beeja Mantra for Brihaspati/Jupiter

Om Gram Greem Graum Sah Guruve Namah ||

You can choose to reenergize the Heliodor on a Thursday.

Now, wear your Heliodor to appease Lord Brihaspati and receive its blessings.

How to Check if Heliodor suits you?

Preferably, a powerful gemstone such as Heliodor should only be worn after consultation with an RRCT specialist. Nevertheless, it will be appropriate if worn according to RRCT, and we will add bhasm and energize it for only positive effects.

You can also give yourself at least 72 hours after embracing a Heliodor to determine whether or not you are experiencing any negative effects. If after 72 hours of embracing the Heliodor stone you do not feel even the slightest effect, you are safe to use Heliodor, as this shows it is safe and sure for you and it will not negatively affect you in any way.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Heliodor is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life. Heliodor has been considered a gemstone of luck and prosperity for centuries.

How to Know if Heliodor is working?

Within 10 days of wearing, you should notice an increase in emotional, mental, and spiritual vitality. Yellow Beryl encourages a positive attitude toward others and life, as well as a sense of self-empowerment, willpower, and determination. You should feel more secure and emotionally stable, regardless of your life circumstances, and more assertive than you did previously. An overall sense of inner happiness based on inner strength ensures that your beautiful Golden beryl gemstone is working.

How long do the effects of Heliodor last?

If cared for properly, a Heliodor can be worn as jewelry for generations. You must wear it until your chakras are balanced. Typically, experts advise wearing gemstones for four years, after which they are no longer necessary.
tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Heliodor gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Heliodor is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality Yellow Beryl stones are bright yellow in color with hue that is evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality Heliodor stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Heliodor of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger golden beryl gemstones are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Heliodor rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Heliodor gemstones have good transparency, the best are clear with no eye-visible scratches or inclusions.

Traders deal in beryl stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Heliodor Gemstone Price

The value of a golden beryl is determined by its hue and dimensions or carats. Its hues range from light yellow and yellow-green to orange-yellow and deep gold orange. Richer-colored gems weighing up to 10 carats are the most desired and expensive.

Even though pale heliodor isn't as bright as other types of heliodor, it is still very beautiful and often used to make the finest jewelry. It looks elegant and sophisticated because of its soft color and gorgeous shine, and its demand is also increasing in recent times.

Heliodor is a rare gem and, as such, an excellent investment for many. Raw and untreated golden beryl gemstones are not excessively expensive when we consider their shortage of production and extraordinary healing properties. When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Heliodor has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Heliodor stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Heliodor gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 16,830 to INR 35,955 (USD 210 to USD 449).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Heliodor?

The best way to check the authenticity of Heliodor is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Heliodor are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Heliodor carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Heliodor is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Heliodor have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Heliodor, but if you find flaws, then your Heliodor is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Heliodor are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Heliodor. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Heliodor, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Heliodor from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Heliodor. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Heliodor. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Heliodor Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Avoid exposing it to extreme temperatures or direct sunlight, as these can alter its hue and clarity.

Use warm water and gentle soap to gently clean your Heliodor jewelry.
